name: Philip Morris International
hero_kpi_rationale: Le revenu des produits sans fumée (IQOS, ZYN) est le KPI distinctif de la transition de Philip Morris : 16 854 M $ en 2025, en hausse de 15 %, alors que le combustible décline. C'est le moteur de croissance et la thèse d'investissement centrale.

risks.title: Regulatory and Legislative Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a highly regulated industry with strict restrictions on tobacco and nicotine products. Regulatory bodies including the FDA control product authorizations and marketing claims. Changes in regulations or denial of approvals could materially impact business operations and profitability. (score par défaut, à affiner). Citation: "Versions of IQOS devices and consumables and General snus also obtained the first-ever Modified Risk". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Regulatory oversight is a critical risk factor as PMI depends on FDA authorizations for smoke-free products including IQOS and ZYN. Regulatory changes or enforcement actions could limit product commercialization and market growth.

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The smoke-free product market is becoming increasingly competitive with numerous new entrants and established tobacco companies developing competing products. PMI must maintain innovation and market share to sustain profitability. (score par défaut, à affiner). Citation: "Impairment of goodwill and other intangibles During the first quarter of 2024, we recorded an". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Competitive pressure from established and emerging players in the smoke-free market requires continuous innovation, brand investment, and product development to maintain market position and pricing power.

risks.title: Litigation Risk
risks.score_rationale: The company faces potential litigation related to tobacco and nicotine products, including health claims, product liability, and regulatory disputes. These could result in significant financial and reputational damage. (score par défaut, à affiner). Citation: "Versions of IQOS devices and consumables and General snus also obtained the first-ever Modified Risk". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: PMI manages ongoing legal proceedings and potential litigation exposure related to tobacco products and claims about smoke-free alternatives. Legal costs and potential settlements could impact financial results.

risks.title: Geopolitical Risk
risks.score_rationale: PMI operates globally across many countries with exposure to geopolitical tensions, sanctions, currency controls, and political instability. Capital controls in jurisdictions like Russia and Argentina limit dividend repatriation and FX conversion capabilities. (score par défaut, à affiner). Citation: "Versions of IQOS devices and consumables and General snus also obtained the first-ever Modified Risk". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: Geopolitical tensions, trade restrictions, and currency controls in key markets such as Russia and Argentina create operational and financial challenges. PMI holds $2.3 billion in cash in Russia, exposing it to currency devaluation and capital movement restrictions.

risks.title: Reputational Risk
risks.score_rationale: As a tobacco company, PMI faces inherent reputational challenges. Product safety concerns, regulatory setbacks, or failure to deliver on smoke-free transition commitments could damage brand equity and investor confidence. (score par défaut, à affiner). Citation: "Versions of IQOS devices and consumables and General snus also obtained the first-ever Modified Risk". Position: haut Item 1A.
risks.summary: PMI's reputation is critical to its business model and transformation strategy. Any failure to deliver on smoke-free innovation commitments or product safety issues could undermine stakeholder trust and market credibility.

company_description: Philip Morris International Inc. operates as a tobacco company. The company offers cigarettes and smoke-free products, including heat-not-burn, e-vapor, and oral nicotine products under the IQOS, VEEV, and ZYN brands; and consumer accessories, such as lighters and matches. It also offers wellness products. The company was incorporated in 1987 and is headquartered in Stamford, Connecticut.
